summary: Completed comprehensive testing of three new engagement features: early supporter banner, streak milestones with badges, and briefings free banner. All backend APIs and frontend UI elements working correctly.
passed_tests: GET /api/early-supporters returns correct structure {limit: 50, taken, left} with public access (no auth required)
Early supporter count math is correct (left = 50 - taken)
Streak milestone logic: user with current_streak=6 reading today reaches 7-day milestone
Same-day read is idempotent (extended=false, milestone=null, badges preserved)
Badge persistence on streak reset: current_streak resets to 1 after gap, but longest_streak and badges persist
Frontend: Homepage early supporter banner displays with correct count (33 of 50 spots left)
Frontend: Early supporter banner links to /auth
Frontend: Briefings page shows 'Free through Edition #6' banner with countdown
Frontend: Briefings free banner CTA links to /pricing
Frontend: Account page displays streak card with current/longest streak
Frontend: All three milestone badges (7/30/100) display correctly with locked/unlocked states
Frontend: Badge elements have correct data-testids (streak-badge-7, streak-badge-30, streak-badge-100)
